channel.title: ASEAN AI Governance Tracker — Updates
channel.description: What changed in the ASEAN AI Governance Tracker: new cases, official responses and policies, and what is still queued for verification.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-25
item.description: Version 0.5: a new Compute tab, on chips, data centres and verification. It records published data centre capacity by market (with what each figure measures), named projects, and rules, responses and cases about where AI chips go, including the US licence rule for Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. It compares planned with running capacity using one firm's figures, shows a "Can it be checked?" profile of five questions for each member with no total or ranking, lists public signals to check when something is not in the news, and sets out the layers at which compute could be verified, with whose cooperation.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-25
item.description: Method decision: investigations and charges about chips are recorded as reported, and every such row must say that an investigation is not a finding and a charge is an allegation until a court decides. The Compute tab does not name people.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-23
item.description: Weekly update: 2 new incidents (VN-I-09 Quyền Linh fake-arrest deepfakes; ID-I-06 ChatGPT used to plan a Madiun murder), 2 new official responses (VN-R-11 HCMC Police summons; ID-R-12 East Java Police disclosure), 6 new policy instruments (ASEAN-P-10 AIPA AI governance resolution; ASEAN-P-11 ASEAN–China Joint Statement; SG-P-14 Scams (Countermeasures) Act 2026; PH-P-11 HB 10362 National AI Governance Act; PH-P-12 Supreme Court judiciary AI framework; PH-P-13 BSP STARS AI governance principles). Totals now 55 incidents, 79 responses, 97 instruments. Backlog 84 → 85 items (3 cleared, 4 added, 6 updated). Version 0.4.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-23
item.description: Sweeps this run: OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor (Grok entry, Madiun 2026-11-01-7c7b, Quyền Linh 2025-12-08-ef7a); AIPA 47th General Assembly and 29th ASEAN-China Summit texts (asean.org); Singapore eGazette (Act No. 21 of 2026); Supreme Court E-Library (A.M. No. 25-11-28-SC); BSP (M-2026-031); ministry and regulator pages (IMDA/MDDI, MCMC, Komdigi, DICT/NPC, ETDA/MDES, MIC) and ASEAN Secretariat releases for 21–23 Nov 2026. Checked but not added: Malaysia Fahmi enforcement aggregates (modelling decision needed); Singapore MDDI incident-reporting study (statement of intent only); no Vietnam or Thailand Grok response found; no official response to the Cambodia Kiripost deepfake-porn case; Timor-Leste PM speech full text returns 404 on the government site. BN, LA and MM: no new verified rows this run.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-23
item.description: Template, 2026-11-23: the ASEAN emblem is no longer used; the non-affiliation statement is kept and the Method section explains this. Added a Back to top button and footer links, and a header link to AI Benar Advisory. The privacy notice link now points to its GitHub copy, so it works however the site is hosted. Map tiles: accessible names now start with their visible text (code, name, number) for voice-control users, hover tooltips are hidden from screen readers (the label carries the same details), and empty-tile names meet 4.5:1 contrast.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-22
item.description: Audit and compliance fixes: VN-I-08 and VN-R-10 anonymised — the alleged ringleader's name withheld (private individual, accused not convicted, no official source names him); VN-I-08 counts softened to the Vietstock/VietNamNet report ('nearly 1,000' accounts), period/profit figures from the non-official Cafebiz republication removed. MY-I-03 now cites Media Selangor (19 Oct 2026) instead of the AI Risk Wire aggregator; unverified victim ages and image count removed. ID-I-05 and SG-I-07: schools no longer named in sexual-deepfake cases involving minors (rule adopted; names stay in source links). TH-I-03 and PH-I-04: underlying articles read in full, notes updated. VN-I-04: summary now flags the date as the OECD AIM listing date with onset unconfirmed. Template: dark-mode selected-state contrast fixed (--sel #2b6cb0), ASEAN-emblem non-affiliation disclaimer added (footer, Method, README), Permissions-Policy meta tag removed (browsers ignore it; it has no meta equivalent). PRIVACY.md corrected on localStorage, GoatCounter domains and collected data. Unused logo-edited.png deleted. No counts changed.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-21
item.description: Saturday one-off update (brought forward from the Wednesday run so the Compliscope Advisory site can quote fresh numbers): 3 new incidents (MY-I-08 second AKPS deepfake; VN-I-07 Lý Hải celebrity deepfakes; VN-I-08 Thanh Hóa biometric bank-fraud ring), 3 new responses (MY-R-15 MCMC takedown of 12 Johor exco accounts; MY-R-16 AKPS denial; VN-R-10 Thanh Hóa arrests), 3 new instruments (PH-P-09 EO 131 AI Governance Framework and National AI Council; PH-P-10 NPC notice on AI likenesses; VN-P-07 Decision 1671 National AI Strategy to 2030). VN-P-04 (Decision 127, 2021) superseded by VN-P-07. Backlog 83 → 84 items (5 cleared, 6 added, 3 updated).

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-21
item.description: Sweeps this run: OECD AI Incidents Monitor (SG AIM 2026-07-07-5a78, MY AIM 2025-12-07-ca89, VN AIM 2026-05-01-a290, VN AIM 2026-11-03-d510); underlying articles (MHA, Malay Mail/Bernama, Kenh14/Danviet, VietNamNet/Cafebiz, Official Gazette of the Philippines, privacy.gov.ph, Straits AI/GINC); ministry and regulator press pages (IMDA/MDDI, MCMC, Komdigi, DICT/CICC/NPC, ETDA/MDES, MIC/MOST) and ASEAN Secretariat releases for 20–21 Nov 2026 — no new developments dated 20–21 Nov found. CCW Seventh Review Conference outcome (21 Nov) checked: out of scope (global UN disarmament process, no ASEAN action).

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-20
item.description: Weekly update (brought forward from 25 Nov): watch list cleared — SG-P-08 and SG-P-10 now in force; ID-P-05 and MY-P-05 still pending with corrected milestones; PH-P-07 lapsed with the 19th Congress. 21 new incidents, 20 new responses, 17 new instruments; first incidents on election-integrity, data-protection and online-safety themes. Backlog 22 → 15 items.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-20
item.description: Sweeps this run: OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor for SG, MY and VN (2025–2026) plus ID election deepfakes; AI Incident Database for PH VP impeachment video (1128), TH PBS/Crystallum (1254, 1255) and KH Hun Sen audio (1127); ministry and regulator press pages (IMDA/MDDI, Komdigi, NAIO/MCMC, DICT/PCO/DOJ, MIC, ETDA/MDES) and ASEAN Secretariat releases.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-20
item.description: ASEAN-11 expansion: Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Brunei and Timor-Leste added to scope; the two-verified-cases rule for adding a country is retired. 10 new incidents, 12 new responses, 28 new instruments. New Review tab for checking an update before merge; SEA-6 / All 11 filter switch; official ASEAN emblem revised to eleven stalks. Held back to backlog: 11 rows (LA-R-01/02/05, LA-P-04/05, MM-I-01/R-01/R-02, BN-P-07, TL-P-03/08) — see review file.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-20
item.description: Sweeps this run: OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor and AI Incident Database for KH, LA, MM, BN and TL; ministry and regulator press pages (MPTC, KPL/MTC, GNLM, AITI/BDCB/RBPF, timor-leste.gov.tl and Ministry of Justice) and national news. Timor-Leste: no verified incident with an official response found — zero is a genuine finding, not a thin sweep. TL-P-04 draft PDF text re-verified against mj.gov.tl.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-15
item.description: Version 0.2: added Thailand; 6 new cases (SG-I-05, TH-I-01 to TH-I-03, PH-I-03, PH-I-04), 8 new official responses and 9 new policies (6 Thailand, 1 Philippines, 2 ASEAN including DEFA, signed 14 Nov 2026). Added an aim_url column linking cases to their OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor record. Added coverage and proof-of-concept notices.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-11-15
item.description: Version 0.3: optional cookieless visitor counting with GoatCounter (off by default, nothing is added to the page unless a site code is set). New Visitors tab with a live total, a region view, a country table, referring sites, tab use and downloads, shown only after 30 visits and with groups under 3 merged. New fetch_stats.py and a daily GitHub workflow refresh the country snapshot. No cookies; nothing is counted for Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control or local files.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-10-28
item.description: Version 0.1: first release with 13 cases, 34 official responses and 34 policy instruments across ASEAN, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and the Philippines. Every row has a source link and a confidence rating.

item.title: Tracker update — 2026-10-28
item.description: Method decision: any action by a government body or a person with official authority counts as a response (statements, warnings, advisories, investigations, orders, laws).
